source: Local OpenStreetMap Standard exports supplied for this project
projection: EPSG:3857 Web Mercator; north-up; GPS is projected before conversion to the registered raster plane
registrationMethod: Feature-match the same-scale detail PNG overlaps with SIFT/RANSAC, then anchor the detail mosaic to the supplied approximate northwest panel center. Register the overview to the detail mosaic with a robust similarity transform.

anchor.confidence: Approximate export center supplied by user

detailPanels.coverage: northeast / eastern campus and sports edge
southwest / academic core and west approach
southeast / sports complex and southern campus

excludedDuplicate.reason: Near-duplicate of map (2).png; feature fit scale 1.00005, translation about (0.0, -1.5) pixels. Preserved in the project root but not drawn over the same coverage.

gpsValidation.result: Visual sanity check against labels and footprints across the hostel, academic, gate, and sports areas. No independent survey pixels were supplied, so no GPS residual is claimed.
gpsValidation.uncertainty: Panel centers are approximate. Main Gate and some building-center-to-entrance offsets remain approximate; preserve the supplied GPS coordinates and review access links against the map.

initialViewBox.fitBehavior: Expanded to the map viewport aspect ratio while preserving square Web Mercator pixels.
